overview: The Commission approved one-day liquor license applications for a restaurant grand opening and a university event, and tabled a hearing regarding Great American Beer Hall.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The Commission approved the minutes from the January 28, 2026 meeting.

items.title: WANDA One-Day License Application
items.summary: Approved a one-day liquor license for a grand opening event on March 5, 2026, which will include beer samples.

items.title: Tufts University One-Day License Application
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for a senior jazz night on February 20, 2026, at the Joyce Cummings Center.

items.title: Great American Beer Hall Hearing
items.summary: Tabled the hearing until the next meeting because the petitioner was not present.
